title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.00 (quiet) at 18:00 UTC on 19 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 19 日 18:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest hour-start estimated Kp = 0.00 (label 0Z). Last-180-sample maximum is 1.67 (at 17:32 UTC); published-window maximum is 1.67 (at 14:52 UTC). Hours through 11:00 UTC have rolled out of the public window. Completed bins 12:00–17:00 UTC closed at 0.67 / 1.00 / 1.67 / 1.00 / 1.33 / 1.67 respectively (12:00 partial from 12:07, peak 0.67 / 1M; 13:00 peak 1.00 / 1Z; 14:00 peak 1.67 / 2M at 14:52, closed at 1.67 / 2M; 15:00 peak 1.00 / 1Z at 15:27; 16:00 peak 1.33 / 1P at 16:49, closed at 1.33 / 1P; 17:00 peak 1.67 / 2M at 17:32, closed at 1.67 / 2M). 18:00 UTC bin is in progress (5 samples; peak 0.00 / 0Z at 18:00, last 0.00 / 0Z at 18:04). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute (18:00 UTC). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window (~358 samples), so earlier hours fall out of the file. The in-progress 18:00 UTC hour currently ends at 0.00 / 0Z and may be revised as NOAA updates.

title.en: A magnitude 4.5 earthquake occurred 273 km NNW of Dêqên, China on 19 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 19 日，中國德欽北北西約 273 公里發生規模 4.5 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mb 4.5, depth about 10 km. Newly listed this hour. Current day-feed maximum remains mww 5.5 (us7000tigd).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mb 4.5，深度約 10 公里。本輪新上架。一日饋送目前最大仍為 mww 5.5（us7000tigd）。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events.
